intro: Designed for the way you work. Whether you’re in back-to-back meetings or deep focus mode, this ergonomic mesh chair keeps you supported and comfortable—so you can stay productive the stress!

features.title: Adaptable design for modern workspaces
features.text: The Thrill Mesh Chair was created to meet the needs of dynamic offices. With its contemporary look and customisable features, it seamlessly integrates into collaborative spaces or personal workstations. Whatever your work style, this chair adapts to support you all day long.

features.title: Support that moves with you
features.text: Stay cool and comfortable with the breathable mesh backrest, while the contoured seat and waterfall edge relieve leg pressure and boost circulation—keeping you focused and fatigue-free.

features.title: Innovative lumbar support that moves with you
features.text: Inspired by the shape of a mermaid’s tail, the lumbar support offers dual-panel adjustability to align with your movements—keeping your spine supported no matter how you sit.

features.title: Comfort tailored to your needs
features.text: With seat height adjustments and a centre tilt mechanism, you can recline comfortably while the three-point locking system ensures you stay secure in your preferred position.

features.title: Move freely, stay supported
features.text: The 360-degree swivel base and smooth casters let you move effortlessly across your workspace while the sturdy frame keeps you stable.

features.title: Built to last through every workday
features.text: Made with high-quality materials and rigorously tested, this chair is designed to perform reliably for years—making it a smart, long-term investment.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
